 585 def get_openapi(
 586     *,
 587     title: str,
 588     version: str,
 589     openapi_version: str = "3.1.0",
 590     summary: str | None = None,
 591     description: str | None = None,
 592     routes: Sequence[BaseRoute | routing.RouteContext],
 593     webhooks: Sequence[BaseRoute | routing.RouteContext] | None = None,
 594     tags: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
 595     servers: list[dict[str, str | Any]] | None = None,
 596     terms_of_service: str | None = None,
 597     contact: dict[str, str | Any] | None = None,
 598     license_info: dict[str, str | Any] | None = None,
 599     separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True,
 600     external_docs: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
 601 ) -> dict[str, Any]:
 602     info: dict[str, Any] = {"title": title, "version": version}
 603     if summary:
 604         info["summary"] = summary
 605     if description:
 606         info["description"] = description
 607     if terms_of_service:
 608         info["termsOfService"] = terms_of_service
 609     if contact:
 610         info["contact"] = contact
 611     if license_info:
 612         info["license"] = license_info
 613     output: dict[str, Any] = {"openapi": openapi_version, "info": info}
 614     if servers:
 615         output["servers"] = servers
 616     components: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 617     paths: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 618     webhook_paths: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 619     operation_ids: set[str] = set()
 620     all_fields = get_fields_from_routes(list(routes) + list(webhooks or []))
 621     flat_models = get_flat_models_from_fields(all_fields, known_models=set())
 622     model_name_map = get_model_name_map(flat_models)
 623     field_mapping, definitions = get_definitions(
 624         fields=all_fields,
 625         model_name_map=model_name_map,
 626         separate_input_output_schemas=separate_input_output_schemas,
 627     )
 628     for route_context in routing.iter_route_contexts(routes):
 629         api_route = _get_api_route_for_openapi(route_context)
 630         if api_route is not None:
 631             result = get_openapi_path(
 632                 route=api_route,
 633                 operation_ids=operation_ids,
 634                 model_name_map=model_name_map,
 635                 field_mapping=field_mapping,
 636                 separate_input_output_schemas=separate_input_output_schemas,
 637             )
 638             if result:
 639                 path, security_schemes, path_definitions = result
 640                 if path:
 641                     paths.setdefault(api_route.path_format, {}).update(path)
 642                 if security_schemes:
 643                     components.setdefault("securitySchemes", {}).update(
 644                         security_schemes
 645                     )
 646                 if path_definitions:
 647                     definitions.update(path_definitions)
 648     for webhook_context in routing.iter_route_contexts(webhooks or []):
 649         api_webhook = _get_api_route_for_openapi(webhook_context)
 650         if api_webhook is not None:
 651             result = get_openapi_path(
 652                 route=api_webhook,
 653                 operation_ids=operation_ids,
 654                 model_name_map=model_name_map,
 655                 field_mapping=field_mapping,
 656                 separate_input_output_schemas=separate_input_output_schemas,
 657             )
 658             if result:
 659                 path, security_schemes, path_definitions = result
 660                 if path:
 661                     webhook_paths.setdefault(api_webhook.path_format, {}).update(path)
 662                 if security_schemes:
 663                     components.setdefault("securitySchemes", {}).update(
 664                         security_schemes
 665                     )
 666                 if path_definitions:
 667                     definitions.update(path_definitions)
 668     if definitions:
 669         components["schemas"] = {k: definitions[k] for k in sorted(definitions)}
 670     if components:
 671         output["components"] = components
 672     output["paths"] = paths
 673     if webhook_paths:
 674         output["webhooks"] = webhook_paths
 675     if tags:
 676         output["tags"] = tags
 677     if external_docs:
 678         output["externalDocs"] = external_docs
 679     return jsonable_encoder(OpenAPI(**output), by_alias=True, exclude_none=True)  # type: ignore[no-any-return]

1020     def build_middleware_stack(self) -> ASGIApp:
1021         # Duplicate/override from Starlette to add AsyncExitStackMiddleware
1022         # inside of ExceptionMiddleware, inside of custom user middlewares
1023         debug = self.debug
1024         error_handler = None
1025         exception_handlers: dict[Any, ExceptionHandler] = {}
1026 
1027         for key, value in self.exception_handlers.items():
1028             if key in (500, Exception):
1029                 error_handler = value
1030             else:
1031                 exception_handlers[key] = value
1032 
1033         middleware = (
1034             [Middleware(ServerErrorMiddleware, handler=error_handler, debug=debug)]
1035             + self.user_middleware
1036             + [
1037                 Middleware(
1038                     ExceptionMiddleware,
1039                     handlers=exception_handlers,
1040                     debug=debug,
1041                 ),
1042                 # Add FastAPI-specific AsyncExitStackMiddleware for closing files.
1043                 # Before this was also used for closing dependencies with yield but
1044                 # those now have their own AsyncExitStack, to properly support
1045                 # streaming responses while keeping compatibility with the previous
1046                 # versions (as of writing 0.117.1) that allowed doing
1047                 # except HTTPException inside a dependency with yield.
1048                 # This needs to happen after user middlewares because those create a
1049                 # new contextvars context copy by using a new AnyIO task group.
1050                 # This AsyncExitStack preserves the context for contextvars, not
1051                 # strictly necessary for closing files but it was one of the original
1052                 # intentions.
1053                 # If the AsyncExitStack lived outside of the custom middlewares and
1054                 # contextvars were set, for example in a dependency with 'yield'
1055                 # in that internal contextvars context, the values would not be
1056                 # available in the outer context of the AsyncExitStack.
1057                 # By placing the middleware and the AsyncExitStack here, inside all
1058                 # user middlewares, the same context is used.
1059                 # This is currently not needed, only for closing files, but used to be
1060                 # important when dependencies with yield were closed here.
1061                 Middleware(AsyncExitStackMiddleware),
1062             ]
1063         )
1064 
1065         app = self.router
1066         for cls, args, kwargs in reversed(middleware):
1067             app = cls(app, *args, **kwargs)
1068         return app

1020     def build_middleware_stack(self) -> ASGIApp:
1021         # Duplicate/override from Starlette to add AsyncExitStackMiddleware
1022         # inside of ExceptionMiddleware, inside of custom user middlewares
1023         debug = self.debug
1024         error_handler = None
1025         exception_handlers: dict[Any, ExceptionHandler] = {}
1026 
1027         for key, value in self.exception_handlers.items():
1028             if key in (500, Exception):
1029                 error_handler = value
1030             else:
1031                 exception_handlers[key] = value
1032 
1033         middleware = (
1034             [Middleware(ServerErrorMiddleware, handler=error_handler, debug=debug)]
1035             + self.user_middleware
1036             + [
1037                 Middleware(
1038                     ExceptionMiddleware,
1039                     handlers=exception_handlers,
1040                     debug=debug,
1041                 ),
1042                 # Add FastAPI-specific AsyncExitStackMiddleware for closing files.
1043                 # Before this was also used for closing dependencies with yield but
1044                 # those now have their own AsyncExitStack, to properly support
1045                 # streaming responses while keeping compatibility with the previous
1046                 # versions (as of writing 0.117.1) that allowed doing
1047                 # except HTTPException inside a dependency with yield.
1048                 # This needs to happen after user middlewares because those create a
1049                 # new contextvars context copy by using a new AnyIO task group.
1050                 # This AsyncExitStack preserves the context for contextvars, not
1051                 # strictly necessary for closing files but it was one of the original
1052                 # intentions.
1053                 # If the AsyncExitStack lived outside of the custom middlewares and
1054                 # contextvars were set, for example in a dependency with 'yield'
1055                 # in that internal contextvars context, the values would not be
1056                 # available in the outer context of the AsyncExitStack.
1057                 # By placing the middleware and the AsyncExitStack here, inside all
1058                 # user middlewares, the same context is used.
1059                 # This is currently not needed, only for closing files, but used to be
1060                 # important when dependencies with yield were closed here.
1061                 Middleware(AsyncExitStackMiddleware),
1062             ]
1063         )
1064 
1065         app = self.router
1066         for cls, args, kwargs in reversed(middleware):
1067             app = cls(app, *args, **kwargs)
1068         return app

2811     def _match_low_priority(
2812         self, scope: Scope
2813     ) -> tuple[Match, Scope, BaseRoute | None, _EffectiveRouteContext | None]:
2814         full: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2815         partial: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2816         for candidate in self._iter_low_priority_routes():
2817             route: BaseRoute
2818             if isinstance(candidate, _EffectiveRouteContext):
2819                 route_context: _EffectiveRouteContext | None = candidate
2820                 original_route = candidate.original_route
2821                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2822                     fastapi_scope = _get_fastapi_scope(scope)
2823                     previous_context = fastapi_scope.get(
2824                         _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY, _SCOPE_MISSING
2825                     )
2826                     fastapi_scope[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = route_context
2827                     try:
2828                         match, child_scope = original_route.matches(scope)
2829                     finally:
2830                         _restore_fastapi_scope_key(
2831                             scope,
2832                             _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY,
2833                             previous_context,
2834                         )
2835                     route = original_route
2836                 else:
2837                     match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2838                     route = candidate.starlette_route or original_route
2839             else:
2840                 route_context = None
2841                 match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2842                 route = candidate
2843             if match == Match.FULL:
2844                 if full is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2845                     child_scope, full[0]
2846                 ):
2847                     full = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2848             elif match == Match.PARTIAL:
2849                 if partial is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2850                     child_scope, partial[0]
2851                 ):
2852                     partial = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2853         if full is not None:
2854             child_scope, route, route_context = full
2855             return Match.FULL, child_scope, route, route_context
2856         if partial is not None:
2857             child_scope, route, route_context = partial
2858             return Match.PARTIAL, child_scope, route, route_context
2859         return Match.NONE, {}, None, None

2861     def _frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2862         self, child_scope: Scope, previous_child_scope: Scope
2863     ) -> bool:

2865         previous_specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(previous_child_scope)
2866         if specificity is None or previous_specificity is None:
2867             return False
2868         return specificity > previous_specificity

1252         effective_context = _get_scope_effective_route_context(scope)
1253         if effective_context is not None and effective_context.original_route is self:
1254             match, child_scope = effective_context.matches(scope)
1255         else:
1256             match, child_scope = super().matches(scope)
1257         if match != Match.NONE:
1258             child_scope["route"] = self
1259         return match, child_scope

1261     async def handle(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
1262         effective_context = _get_scope_effective_route_context(scope)
1263         if effective_context is not None and effective_context.original_route is self:
1264             methods = effective_context.methods
1265             if methods and scope["method"] not in methods:
1266                 headers = {"Allow": ", ".join(methods)}
1267                 if "app" in scope:
1268                     raise HTTPException(status_code=405, headers=headers)
1269                 response = PlainTextResponse(
1270                     "Method Not Allowed", status_code=405, headers=headers
1271                 )
1272                 await response(scope, receive, send)
1273                 return
1274             token = _effective_route_context_var.set(effective_context)
1275             try:
1276                 app = request_response(self.get_route_handler())
1277             finally:
1278                 _effective_route_context_var.reset(token)
1279             await app(scope, receive, send)
1280             return

1020     def build_middleware_stack(self) -> ASGIApp:
1021         # Duplicate/override from Starlette to add AsyncExitStackMiddleware
1022         # inside of ExceptionMiddleware, inside of custom user middlewares
1023         debug = self.debug
1024         error_handler = None
1025         exception_handlers: dict[Any, ExceptionHandler] = {}
1026 
1027         for key, value in self.exception_handlers.items():
1028             if key in (500, Exception):
1029                 error_handler = value
1030             else:
1031                 exception_handlers[key] = value
1032 
1033         middleware = (
1034             [Middleware(ServerErrorMiddleware, handler=error_handler, debug=debug)]
1035             + self.user_middleware
1036             + [
1037                 Middleware(
1038                     ExceptionMiddleware,
1039                     handlers=exception_handlers,
1040                     debug=debug,
1041                 ),
1042                 # Add FastAPI-specific AsyncExitStackMiddleware for closing files.
1043                 # Before this was also used for closing dependencies with yield but
1044                 # those now have their own AsyncExitStack, to properly support
1045                 # streaming responses while keeping compatibility with the previous
1046                 # versions (as of writing 0.117.1) that allowed doing
1047                 # except HTTPException inside a dependency with yield.
1048                 # This needs to happen after user middlewares because those create a
1049                 # new contextvars context copy by using a new AnyIO task group.
1050                 # This AsyncExitStack preserves the context for contextvars, not
1051                 # strictly necessary for closing files but it was one of the original
1052                 # intentions.
1053                 # If the AsyncExitStack lived outside of the custom middlewares and
1054                 # contextvars were set, for example in a dependency with 'yield'
1055                 # in that internal contextvars context, the values would not be
1056                 # available in the outer context of the AsyncExitStack.
1057                 # By placing the middleware and the AsyncExitStack here, inside all
1058                 # user middlewares, the same context is used.
1059                 # This is currently not needed, only for closing files, but used to be
1060                 # important when dependencies with yield were closed here.
1061                 Middleware(AsyncExitStackMiddleware),
1062             ]
1063         )
1064 
1065         app = self.router
1066         for cls, args, kwargs in reversed(middleware):
1067             app = cls(app, *args, **kwargs)
1068         return app

2727             return

2729         partial: tuple[BaseRoute, Scope] | None = None

2731             match, child_scope = route.matches(scope)
2732             if match == Match.FULL:
2733                 scope.update(child_scope)
2734                 await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2735                 return
2736             if match == Match.PARTIAL and partial is None:
2737                 partial = (route, child_scope)
2738 
2739         if partial is not None:
2740             route, child_scope = partial
2741             scope.update(child_scope)

2743             return

2813     ) -> tuple[Match, Scope, BaseRoute | None, _EffectiveRouteContext | None]:
2814         full: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2815         partial: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2816         for candidate in self._iter_low_priority_routes():
2817             route: BaseRoute
2818             if isinstance(candidate, _EffectiveRouteContext):
2819                 route_context: _EffectiveRouteContext | None = candidate
2820                 original_route = candidate.original_route
2821                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2822                     fastapi_scope = _get_fastapi_scope(scope)
2823                     previous_context = fastapi_scope.get(
2824                         _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY, _SCOPE_MISSING
2825                     )
2826                     fastapi_scope[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = route_context
2827                     try:
2828                         match, child_scope = original_route.matches(scope)
2829                     finally:
2830                         _restore_fastapi_scope_key(
2831                             scope,
2832                             _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY,
2833                             previous_context,
2834                         )
2835                     route = original_route
2836                 else:
2837                     match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2838                     route = candidate.starlette_route or original_route
2839             else:
2840                 route_context = None
2841                 match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2842                 route = candidate
2843             if match == Match.FULL:
2844                 if full is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2845                     child_scope, full[0]
2846                 ):
2847                     full = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2848             elif match == Match.PARTIAL:
2849                 if partial is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2850                     child_scope, partial[0]
2851                 ):
2852                     partial = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2853         if full is not None:
2854             child_scope, route, route_context = full
2855             return Match.FULL, child_scope, route, route_context
2856         if partial is not None:
2857             child_scope, route, route_context = partial
2858             return Match.PARTIAL, child_scope, route, route_context
2859         return Match.NONE, {}, None, None
2860 
2861     def _frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2862         self, child_scope: Scope, previous_child_scope: Scope
2863     ) -> bool:
2864         specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(child_scope)
2865         previous_specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(previous_child_scope)
2866         if specificity is None or previous_specificity is None:
2867             return False
2868         return specificity > previous_specificity

1020     def build_middleware_stack(self) -> ASGIApp:
1021         # Duplicate/override from Starlette to add AsyncExitStackMiddleware
1022         # inside of ExceptionMiddleware, inside of custom user middlewares
1023         debug = self.debug
1024         error_handler = None
1025         exception_handlers: dict[Any, ExceptionHandler] = {}
1026 
1027         for key, value in self.exception_handlers.items():
1028             if key in (500, Exception):
1029                 error_handler = value
1030             else:
1031                 exception_handlers[key] = value
1032 
1033         middleware = (
1034             [Middleware(ServerErrorMiddleware, handler=error_handler, debug=debug)]
1035             + self.user_middleware
1036             + [
1037                 Middleware(
1038                     ExceptionMiddleware,
1039                     handlers=exception_handlers,
1040                     debug=debug,
1041                 ),
1042                 # Add FastAPI-specific AsyncExitStackMiddleware for closing files.
1043                 # Before this was also used for closing dependencies with yield but
1044                 # those now have their own AsyncExitStack, to properly support
1045                 # streaming responses while keeping compatibility with the previous
1046                 # versions (as of writing 0.117.1) that allowed doing
1047                 # except HTTPException inside a dependency with yield.
1048                 # This needs to happen after user middlewares because those create a
1049                 # new contextvars context copy by using a new AnyIO task group.
1050                 # This AsyncExitStack preserves the context for contextvars, not
1051                 # strictly necessary for closing files but it was one of the original
1052                 # intentions.
1053                 # If the AsyncExitStack lived outside of the custom middlewares and
1054                 # contextvars were set, for example in a dependency with 'yield'
1055                 # in that internal contextvars context, the values would not be
1056                 # available in the outer context of the AsyncExitStack.
1057                 # By placing the middleware and the AsyncExitStack here, inside all
1058                 # user middlewares, the same context is used.
1059                 # This is currently not needed, only for closing files, but used to be
1060                 # important when dependencies with yield were closed here.
1061                 Middleware(AsyncExitStackMiddleware),
1062             ]
1063         )
1064 
1065         app = self.router
1066         for cls, args, kwargs in reversed(middleware):
1067             app = cls(app, *args, **kwargs)
1068         return app

1020     def build_middleware_stack(self) -> ASGIApp:
1021         # Duplicate/override from Starlette to add AsyncExitStackMiddleware
1022         # inside of ExceptionMiddleware, inside of custom user middlewares
1023         debug = self.debug
1024         error_handler = None
1025         exception_handlers: dict[Any, ExceptionHandler] = {}
1026 
1027         for key, value in self.exception_handlers.items():
1028             if key in (500, Exception):
1029                 error_handler = value
1030             else:
1031                 exception_handlers[key] = value
1032 
1033         middleware = (
1034             [Middleware(ServerErrorMiddleware, handler=error_handler, debug=debug)]
1035             + self.user_middleware
1036             + [
1037                 Middleware(
1038                     ExceptionMiddleware,
1039                     handlers=exception_handlers,
1040                     debug=debug,
1041                 ),
1042                 # Add FastAPI-specific AsyncExitStackMiddleware for closing files.
1043                 # Before this was also used for closing dependencies with yield but
1044                 # those now have their own AsyncExitStack, to properly support
1045                 # streaming responses while keeping compatibility with the previous
1046                 # versions (as of writing 0.117.1) that allowed doing
1047                 # except HTTPException inside a dependency with yield.
1048                 # This needs to happen after user middlewares because those create a
1049                 # new contextvars context copy by using a new AnyIO task group.
1050                 # This AsyncExitStack preserves the context for contextvars, not
1051                 # strictly necessary for closing files but it was one of the original
1052                 # intentions.
1053                 # If the AsyncExitStack lived outside of the custom middlewares and
1054                 # contextvars were set, for example in a dependency with 'yield'
1055                 # in that internal contextvars context, the values would not be
1056                 # available in the outer context of the AsyncExitStack.
1057                 # By placing the middleware and the AsyncExitStack here, inside all
1058                 # user middlewares, the same context is used.
1059                 # This is currently not needed, only for closing files, but used to be
1060                 # important when dependencies with yield were closed here.
1061                 Middleware(AsyncExitStackMiddleware),
1062             ]
1063         )
1064 
1065         app = self.router
1066         for cls, args, kwargs in reversed(middleware):
1067             app = cls(app, *args, **kwargs)
1068         return app

2719     async def app(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
2720         assert scope["type"] in ("http", "websocket", "lifespan")
2721 
2722         if "router" not in scope:
2723             scope["router"] = self
2724 
2725         if scope["type"] == "lifespan":
2726             await self.lifespan(scope, receive, send)
2727             return
2728 
2729         partial: tuple[BaseRoute, Scope] | None = None
2730         for route in self.routes:
2731             match, child_scope = route.matches(scope)
2732             if match == Match.FULL:
2733                 scope.update(child_scope)
2734                 await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2735                 return
2736             if match == Match.PARTIAL and partial is None:
2737                 partial = (route, child_scope)
2738 
2739         if partial is not None:
2740             route, child_scope = partial
2741             scope.update(child_scope)
2742             await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2743             return
2744 
2745         route_path = get_route_path(scope)
2746         if scope["type"] == "http" and self.redirect_slashes and route_path != "/":
2747             redirect_scope = dict(scope)
2748             if route_path.endswith("/"):
2749                 redirect_scope["path"] = redirect_scope["path"].rstrip("/")
2750             else:
2751                 redirect_scope["path"] = redirect_scope["path"] + "/"
2752 
2753             for route in self.routes:
2754                 match, _ = route.matches(redirect_scope)
2755                 if match != Match.NONE:
2756                     redirect_url = URL(scope=redirect_scope)
2757                     response = RedirectResponse(url=str(redirect_url))
2758                     await response(scope, receive, send)
2759                     return
2760 
2761         (
2762             low_priority_match,
2763             low_priority_scope,
2764             low_priority_route,
2765             low_priority_context,
2766         ) = self._match_low_priority(scope)
2767         if low_priority_match != Match.NONE and low_priority_route is not None:
2768             _update_scope(scope, low_priority_scope)
2769             if low_priority_context is not None:
2770                 _get_fastapi_scope(scope)[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = (
2771                     low_priority_context
2772                 )
2773                 original_route = low_priority_context.original_route
2774                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2775                     scope["route"] = original_route
2776                     await original_route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2777                     return
2778             await low_priority_route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2779             return
2780 
2781         await self.default(scope, receive, send)
2782 
2783     async def handle(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
2784         included_router = _get_scope_included_router(scope)
2785         if (
2786             isinstance(included_router, _IncludedRouter)
2787             and included_router.original_router is self
2788         ):
2789             await included_router._handle_selected(scope, receive, send)
2790             return
2791         await self.app(scope, receive, send)

2797             and included_router.original_router is self
2798         ):
2799             match, child_scope, _, _ = included_router._match(scope)

2811     def _match_low_priority(
2812         self, scope: Scope
2813     ) -> tuple[Match, Scope, BaseRoute | None, _EffectiveRouteContext | None]:
2814         full: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2815         partial: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2816         for candidate in self._iter_low_priority_routes():
2817             route: BaseRoute
2818             if isinstance(candidate, _EffectiveRouteContext):
2819                 route_context: _EffectiveRouteContext | None = candidate
2820                 original_route = candidate.original_route
2821                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2822                     fastapi_scope = _get_fastapi_scope(scope)
2823                     previous_context = fastapi_scope.get(
2824                         _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY, _SCOPE_MISSING
2825                     )
2826                     fastapi_scope[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = route_context
2827                     try:
2828                         match, child_scope = original_route.matches(scope)
2829                     finally:
2830                         _restore_fastapi_scope_key(
2831                             scope,
2832                             _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY,
2833                             previous_context,
2834                         )
2835                     route = original_route
2836                 else:
2837                     match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2838                     route = candidate.starlette_route or original_route
2839             else:
2840                 route_context = None
2841                 match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2842                 route = candidate
2843             if match == Match.FULL:
2844                 if full is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2845                     child_scope, full[0]
2846                 ):
2847                     full = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2848             elif match == Match.PARTIAL:
2849                 if partial is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2850                     child_scope, partial[0]
2851                 ):
2852                     partial = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2853         if full is not None:
2854             child_scope, route, route_context = full
2855             return Match.FULL, child_scope, route, route_context
2856         if partial is not None:
2857             child_scope, route, route_context = partial
2858             return Match.PARTIAL, child_scope, route, route_context
2859         return Match.NONE, {}, None, None
2860 
2861     def _frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2862         self, child_scope: Scope, previous_child_scope: Scope
2863     ) -> bool:
2864         specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(child_scope)
2865         previous_specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(previous_child_scope)
2866         if specificity is None or previous_specificity is None:
2867             return False
2868         return specificity > previous_specificity

2573     def _get_routes_version(self, seen: set[int] | None = None) -> int:
2574         if seen is None:
2575             seen = set()
2576         router_id = id(self)
2577         if router_id in seen:
2578             return self._routes_version
2579         seen.add(router_id)
2580         version = self._routes_version
2581         for route in self.routes:
2582             if isinstance(route, _IncludedRouter):
2583                 version += route.original_router._get_routes_version(seen)
2584         return version

2586     def _contains_router(
2587         self, router: "APIRouter", seen: set[int] | None = None
2588     ) -> bool:
2589         if seen is None:
2590             seen = set()
2591         router_id = id(self)
2592         if router_id in seen:
2593             return False
2594         seen.add(router_id)
2595         for route in self.routes:
2596             if not isinstance(route, _IncludedRouter):
2597                 continue
2598             if route.original_router is router:
2599                 return True
2600             if route.original_router._contains_router(router, seen):
2601                 return True
2602         return False

2719     async def app(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
2720         assert scope["type"] in ("http", "websocket", "lifespan")
2721 
2722         if "router" not in scope:
2723             scope["router"] = self
2724 
2725         if scope["type"] == "lifespan":
2726             await self.lifespan(scope, receive, send)
2727             return
2728 
2729         partial: tuple[BaseRoute, Scope] | None = None
2730         for route in self.routes:
2731             match, child_scope = route.matches(scope)
2732             if match == Match.FULL:
2733                 scope.update(child_scope)
2734                 await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2735                 return
2736             if match == Match.PARTIAL and partial is None:
2737                 partial = (route, child_scope)
2738 
2739         if partial is not None:
2740             route, child_scope = partial
2741             scope.update(child_scope)
2742             await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2743             return
2744 
2745         route_path = get_route_path(scope)
2746         if scope["type"] == "http" and self.redirect_slashes and route_path != "/":
2747             redirect_scope = dict(scope)
2748             if route_path.endswith("/"):
2749                 redirect_scope["path"] = redirect_scope["path"].rstrip("/")
2750             else:
2751                 redirect_scope["path"] = redirect_scope["path"] + "/"
2752 
2753             for route in self.routes:
2754                 match, _ = route.matches(redirect_scope)
2755                 if match != Match.NONE:
2756                     redirect_url = URL(scope=redirect_scope)
2757                     response = RedirectResponse(url=str(redirect_url))
2758                     await response(scope, receive, send)
2759                     return
2760 
2761         (
2762             low_priority_match,
2763             low_priority_scope,
2764             low_priority_route,
2765             low_priority_context,
2766         ) = self._match_low_priority(scope)
2767         if low_priority_match != Match.NONE and low_priority_route is not None:
2768             _update_scope(scope, low_priority_scope)
2769             if low_priority_context is not None:
2770                 _get_fastapi_scope(scope)[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = (
2771                     low_priority_context
2772                 )
2773                 original_route = low_priority_context.original_route
2774                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2775                     scope["route"] = original_route
2776                     await original_route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2777                     return
2778             await low_priority_route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2779             return
2780 
2781         await self.default(scope, receive, send)
2782 
2783     async def handle(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
2784         included_router = _get_scope_included_router(scope)
2785         if (
2786             isinstance(included_router, _IncludedRouter)
2787             and included_router.original_router is self
2788         ):
2789             await included_router._handle_selected(scope, receive, send)
2790             return
2791         await self.app(scope, receive, send)

2793     def matches(self, scope: Scope) -> tuple[Match, Scope]:
2794         included_router = _get_scope_included_router(scope)
2795         if (
2796             isinstance(included_router, _IncludedRouter)
2797             and included_router.original_router is self
2798         ):
2799             match, child_scope, _, _ = included_router._match(scope)
2800             return match, child_scope
2801         return Match.NONE, {}

2804         self,
2805     ) -> Iterator[BaseRoute | _EffectiveRouteContext]:

2807         for route in self.routes:
2808             if isinstance(route, _IncludedRouter):

2811     def _match_low_priority(
2812         self, scope: Scope
2813     ) -> tuple[Match, Scope, BaseRoute | None, _EffectiveRouteContext | None]:
2814         full: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2815         partial: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2816         for candidate in self._iter_low_priority_routes():
2817             route: BaseRoute
2818             if isinstance(candidate, _EffectiveRouteContext):
2819                 route_context: _EffectiveRouteContext | None = candidate
2820                 original_route = candidate.original_route
2821                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2822                     fastapi_scope = _get_fastapi_scope(scope)
2823                     previous_context = fastapi_scope.get(
2824                         _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY, _SCOPE_MISSING
2825                     )
2826                     fastapi_scope[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = route_context
2827                     try:
2828                         match, child_scope = original_route.matches(scope)
2829                     finally:
2830                         _restore_fastapi_scope_key(
2831                             scope,
2832                             _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY,
2833                             previous_context,
2834                         )
2835                     route = original_route
2836                 else:
2837                     match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2838                     route = candidate.starlette_route or original_route
2839             else:
2840                 route_context = None
2841                 match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2842                 route = candidate
2843             if match == Match.FULL:
2844                 if full is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2845                     child_scope, full[0]
2846                 ):
2847                     full = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2848             elif match == Match.PARTIAL:
2849                 if partial is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2850                     child_scope, partial[0]
2851                 ):
2852                     partial = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2853         if full is not None:
2854             child_scope, route, route_context = full
2855             return Match.FULL, child_scope, route, route_context
2856         if partial is not None:
2857             child_scope, route, route_context = partial
2858             return Match.PARTIAL, child_scope, route, route_context
2859         return Match.NONE, {}, None, None
2860 
2861     def _frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2862         self, child_scope: Scope, previous_child_scope: Scope
2863     ) -> bool:
2864         specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(child_scope)
2865         previous_specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(previous_child_scope)
2866         if specificity is None or previous_specificity is None:
2867             return False
2868         return specificity > previous_specificity

2739         if partial is not None:

2811     def _match_low_priority(
2812         self, scope: Scope
2813     ) -> tuple[Match, Scope, BaseRoute | None, _EffectiveRouteContext | None]:
2814         full: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2815         partial: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2816         for candidate in self._iter_low_priority_routes():
2817             route: BaseRoute
2818             if isinstance(candidate, _EffectiveRouteContext):
2819                 route_context: _EffectiveRouteContext | None = candidate
2820                 original_route = candidate.original_route
2821                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2822                     fastapi_scope = _get_fastapi_scope(scope)
2823                     previous_context = fastapi_scope.get(
2824                         _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY, _SCOPE_MISSING
2825                     )
2826                     fastapi_scope[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = route_context
2827                     try:
2828                         match, child_scope = original_route.matches(scope)
2829                     finally:
2830                         _restore_fastapi_scope_key(
2831                             scope,
2832                             _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY,
2833                             previous_context,
2834                         )
2835                     route = original_route
2836                 else:
2837                     match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2838                     route = candidate.starlette_route or original_route
2839             else:
2840                 route_context = None
2841                 match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2842                 route = candidate
2843             if match == Match.FULL:
2844                 if full is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2845                     child_scope, full[0]
2846                 ):
2847                     full = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2848             elif match == Match.PARTIAL:
2849                 if partial is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2850                     child_scope, partial[0]
2851                 ):
2852                     partial = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2853         if full is not None:
2854             child_scope, route, route_context = full
2855             return Match.FULL, child_scope, route, route_context
2856         if partial is not None:
2857             child_scope, route, route_context = partial
2858             return Match.PARTIAL, child_scope, route, route_context
2859         return Match.NONE, {}, None, None
2860 
2861     def _frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2862         self, child_scope: Scope, previous_child_scope: Scope
2863     ) -> bool:
2864         specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(child_scope)
2865         previous_specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(previous_child_scope)
2866         if specificity is None or previous_specificity is None:
2867             return False
2868         return specificity > previous_specificity

1020     def build_middleware_stack(self) -> ASGIApp:
1021         # Duplicate/override from Starlette to add AsyncExitStackMiddleware
1022         # inside of ExceptionMiddleware, inside of custom user middlewares
1023         debug = self.debug
1024         error_handler = None
1025         exception_handlers: dict[Any, ExceptionHandler] = {}
1026 
1027         for key, value in self.exception_handlers.items():
1028             if key in (500, Exception):
1029                 error_handler = value
1030             else:
1031                 exception_handlers[key] = value
1032 
1033         middleware = (
1034             [Middleware(ServerErrorMiddleware, handler=error_handler, debug=debug)]
1035             + self.user_middleware
1036             + [
1037                 Middleware(
1038                     ExceptionMiddleware,
1039                     handlers=exception_handlers,
1040                     debug=debug,
1041                 ),
1042                 # Add FastAPI-specific AsyncExitStackMiddleware for closing files.
1043                 # Before this was also used for closing dependencies with yield but
1044                 # those now have their own AsyncExitStack, to properly support
1045                 # streaming responses while keeping compatibility with the previous
1046                 # versions (as of writing 0.117.1) that allowed doing
1047                 # except HTTPException inside a dependency with yield.
1048                 # This needs to happen after user middlewares because those create a
1049                 # new contextvars context copy by using a new AnyIO task group.
1050                 # This AsyncExitStack preserves the context for contextvars, not
1051                 # strictly necessary for closing files but it was one of the original
1052                 # intentions.
1053                 # If the AsyncExitStack lived outside of the custom middlewares and
1054                 # contextvars were set, for example in a dependency with 'yield'
1055                 # in that internal contextvars context, the values would not be
1056                 # available in the outer context of the AsyncExitStack.
1057                 # By placing the middleware and the AsyncExitStack here, inside all
1058                 # user middlewares, the same context is used.
1059                 # This is currently not needed, only for closing files, but used to be
1060                 # important when dependencies with yield were closed here.
1061                 Middleware(AsyncExitStackMiddleware),
1062             ]
1063         )
1064 
1065         app = self.router
1066         for cls, args, kwargs in reversed(middleware):
1067             app = cls(app, *args, **kwargs)
1068         return app

  11 class OpenIdConnect(SecurityBase):
  12     """
  13     OpenID Connect authentication class. An instance of it would be used as a
  14     dependency.
  15 
  16     **Warning**: this is only a stub to connect the components with OpenAPI in FastAPI,
  17     but it doesn't implement the full OpenIdConnect scheme, for example, it doesn't use
  18     the OpenIDConnect URL. You would need to subclass it and implement it in your
  19     code.
  20     """

  23         self,
  24         *,
  25         openIdConnectUrl: Annotated[
  26             str,
  27             Doc(
  28                 """
  29             The OpenID Connect URL.
  30             """
  31             ),
  32         ],
  33         scheme_name: Annotated[
  34             str | None,
  35             Doc(
  36                 """
  37                 Security scheme name.
  38 
  39                 It will be included in the generated OpenAPI (e.g. visible at `/docs`).
  40                 """
  41             ),
  42         ] = None,
  43         description: Annotated[
  44             str | None,
  45             Doc(
  46                 """
  47                 Security scheme description.
  48 
  49                 It will be included in the generated OpenAPI (e.g. visible at `/docs`).
  50                 """
  51             ),
  52         ] = None,
  53         auto_error: Annotated[
  54             bool,
  55             Doc(
  56                 """
  57                 By default, if no HTTP Authorization header is provided, required for
  58                 OpenID Connect authentication, it will automatically cancel the request
  59                 and send the client an error.
  60 
  61                 If `auto_error` is set to `False`, when the HTTP Authorization header
  62                 is not available, instead of erroring out, the dependency result will
  63                 be `None`.
  64 
  65                 This is useful when you want to have optional authentication.
  66 
  67                 It is also useful when you want to have authentication that can be
  68                 provided in one of multiple optional ways (for example, with OpenID
  69                 Connect or in a cookie).
  70                 """
  71             ),
  72         ] = True,
  73     ):
  74         self.model = OpenIdConnectModel(
  75             openIdConnectUrl=openIdConnectUrl, description=description
  76         )
  77         self.scheme_name = scheme_name or self.__class__.__name__
  78         self.auto_error = auto_error
  79 
  80     def make_not_authenticated_error(self) -> HTTPException:
  81         return HTTPException(
  82             status_code=HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
  83             detail="Not authenticated",
  84             headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
  85         )
  86 
  87     async def __call__(self, request: Request) -> str | None:
  88         authorization = request.headers.get("Authorization")
  89         if not authorization:
  90             if self.auto_error:
  91                 raise self.make_not_authenticated_error()
  92             else:
  93                 return None
  94         return authorization

1020     def build_middleware_stack(self) -> ASGIApp:
1021         # Duplicate/override from Starlette to add AsyncExitStackMiddleware
1022         # inside of ExceptionMiddleware, inside of custom user middlewares
1023         debug = self.debug
1024         error_handler = None
1025         exception_handlers: dict[Any, ExceptionHandler] = {}
1026 
1027         for key, value in self.exception_handlers.items():
1028             if key in (500, Exception):
1029                 error_handler = value
1030             else:
1031                 exception_handlers[key] = value
1032 
1033         middleware = (
1034             [Middleware(ServerErrorMiddleware, handler=error_handler, debug=debug)]
1035             + self.user_middleware
1036             + [
1037                 Middleware(
1038                     ExceptionMiddleware,
1039                     handlers=exception_handlers,
1040                     debug=debug,
1041                 ),
1042                 # Add FastAPI-specific AsyncExitStackMiddleware for closing files.
1043                 # Before this was also used for closing dependencies with yield but
1044                 # those now have their own AsyncExitStack, to properly support
1045                 # streaming responses while keeping compatibility with the previous
1046                 # versions (as of writing 0.117.1) that allowed doing
1047                 # except HTTPException inside a dependency with yield.
1048                 # This needs to happen after user middlewares because those create a
1049                 # new contextvars context copy by using a new AnyIO task group.
1050                 # This AsyncExitStack preserves the context for contextvars, not
1051                 # strictly necessary for closing files but it was one of the original
1052                 # intentions.
1053                 # If the AsyncExitStack lived outside of the custom middlewares and
1054                 # contextvars were set, for example in a dependency with 'yield'
1055                 # in that internal contextvars context, the values would not be
1056                 # available in the outer context of the AsyncExitStack.
1057                 # By placing the middleware and the AsyncExitStack here, inside all
1058                 # user middlewares, the same context is used.
1059                 # This is currently not needed, only for closing files, but used to be
1060                 # important when dependencies with yield were closed here.
1061                 Middleware(AsyncExitStackMiddleware),
1062             ]
1063         )
1064 
1065         app = self.router
1066         for cls, args, kwargs in reversed(middleware):
1067             app = cls(app, *args, **kwargs)
1068         return app

1073         internally.

1075         The first time it is called it stores the result in the attribute
1076         `app.openapi_schema`, and next times it is called, it just returns that same
1077         result. To avoid the cost of generating the schema every time.
1078 
1079         If you need to modify the generated OpenAPI schema, you could modify it.
1080 
1081         Read more in the
1082         [FastAPI docs for OpenAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/how-to/extending-openapi/).
1083         """
1084         routes_version = self.router._get_routes_version()
1085         if not self.openapi_schema or self._openapi_routes_version != routes_version:
1086             self.openapi_schema = get_openapi(
1087                 title=self.title,
1088                 version=self.version,
1089                 openapi_version=self.openapi_version,
1090                 summary=self.summary,
1091                 description=self.description,
1092                 terms_of_service=self.terms_of_service,
1093                 contact=self.contact,
1094                 license_info=self.license_info,
1095                 routes=self.routes,
1096                 webhooks=self.webhooks.routes,
1097                 tags=self.openapi_tags,
1098                 servers=self.servers,
1099                 separate_input_output_schemas=self.separate_input_output_schemas,
1100                 external_docs=self.openapi_external_docs,
1101             )
1102             self._openapi_routes_version = routes_version

2719     async def app(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
2720         assert scope["type"] in ("http", "websocket", "lifespan")
2721 
2722         if "router" not in scope:
2723             scope["router"] = self
2724 
2725         if scope["type"] == "lifespan":
2726             await self.lifespan(scope, receive, send)
2727             return
2728 
2729         partial: tuple[BaseRoute, Scope] | None = None
2730         for route in self.routes:
2731             match, child_scope = route.matches(scope)
2732             if match == Match.FULL:
2733                 scope.update(child_scope)
2734                 await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2735                 return
2736             if match == Match.PARTIAL and partial is None:
2737                 partial = (route, child_scope)
2738 
2739         if partial is not None:
2740             route, child_scope = partial
2741             scope.update(child_scope)
2742             await route.handle(scope, receive, send)
2743             return
2744

2746         if scope["type"] == "http" and self.redirect_slashes and route_path != "/":
2747             redirect_scope = dict(scope)
2748             if route_path.endswith("/"):
2749                 redirect_scope["path"] = redirect_scope["path"].rstrip("/")

2751                 redirect_scope["path"] = redirect_scope["path"] + "/"

2753             for route in self.routes:
2754                 match, _ = route.matches(redirect_scope)

2756                     redirect_url = URL(scope=redirect_scope)

2811     def _match_low_priority(
2812         self, scope: Scope
2813     ) -> tuple[Match, Scope, BaseRoute | None, _EffectiveRouteContext | None]:
2814         full: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2815         partial: tuple[Scope, BaseRoute, _EffectiveRouteContext | None] | None = None
2816         for candidate in self._iter_low_priority_routes():
2817             route: BaseRoute
2818             if isinstance(candidate, _EffectiveRouteContext):
2819                 route_context: _EffectiveRouteContext | None = candidate
2820                 original_route = candidate.original_route
2821                 if isinstance(original_route, APIRoute):
2822                     fastapi_scope = _get_fastapi_scope(scope)
2823                     previous_context = fastapi_scope.get(
2824                         _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY, _SCOPE_MISSING
2825                     )
2826                     fastapi_scope[_FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY] = route_context
2827                     try:
2828                         match, child_scope = original_route.matches(scope)
2829                     finally:
2830                         _restore_fastapi_scope_key(
2831                             scope,
2832                             _FASTAPI_EFFECTIVE_ROUTE_CONTEXT_KEY,
2833                             previous_context,
2834                         )
2835                     route = original_route
2836                 else:
2837                     match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2838                     route = candidate.starlette_route or original_route
2839             else:
2840                 route_context = None
2841                 match, child_scope = candidate.matches(scope)
2842                 route = candidate
2843             if match == Match.FULL:
2844                 if full is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2845                     child_scope, full[0]
2846                 ):
2847                     full = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2848             elif match == Match.PARTIAL:
2849                 if partial is None or self._frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2850                     child_scope, partial[0]
2851                 ):
2852                     partial = (child_scope, route, route_context)
2853         if full is not None:
2854             child_scope, route, route_context = full
2855             return Match.FULL, child_scope, route, route_context
2856         if partial is not None:
2857             child_scope, route, route_context = partial
2858             return Match.PARTIAL, child_scope, route, route_context
2859         return Match.NONE, {}, None, None
2860 
2861     def _frontend_match_is_more_specific(
2862         self, child_scope: Scope, previous_child_scope: Scope
2863     ) -> bool:
2864         specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(child_scope)
2865         previous_specificity = _frontend_scope_specificity(previous_child_scope)
2866         if specificity is None or previous_specificity is None:
2867             return False
2868         return specificity > previous_specificity

 755             continue
 756         # Build the relative path as it appears in includes (e.g. docs_src/first_steps/tutorial001.py)
 757         rel_path = str(py_file)
 758         if rel_path in all_docs_content:
 759             continue
 760         # If this file is inside a directory-based package where any sibling is
 761         # referenced, keep it (it's likely imported internally).
 762         parts = py_file.relative_to(docs_src_path).parts
 763         if len(parts) > 2:
 764             package_root = docs_src_path / parts[0] / parts[1]
 765             if package_root in used_package_dirs:
 766                 continue
 767         # Check if the _an counterpart (or non-_an counterpart) is referenced.
 768         # If either variant is included, keep both.
 769         # Handle both file-level _an (tutorial001_an.py) and directory-level _an
 770         # (app_an/main.py)
 771         counterpart_found = False
 772         full_path_str = str(py_file)
 773         if "_an" in py_file.stem:
 774             # This is an _an file, check if the non-_an version is referenced
 775             counterpart = full_path_str.replace(
 776                 f"/{py_file.stem}", f"/{py_file.stem.replace('_an', '', 1)}"
 777             )
 778             if counterpart in all_docs_content:
 779                 counterpart_found = True
 780         else:
 781             # This is a non-_an file, check if there's an _an version referenced
 782             # Insert _an before any version suffix or at the end of the stem
 783             stem = py_file.stem
 784             for suffix in ("_py39", "_py310"):
 785                 if suffix in stem:
 786                     an_stem = stem.replace(suffix, f"_an{suffix}", 1)
 787                     break
 788             else:
 789                 an_stem = f"{stem}_an"
 790             counterpart = full_path_str.replace(f"/{stem}.", f"/{an_stem}.")
 791             if counterpart in all_docs_content:
 792                 counterpart_found = True
 793         # Also check directory-level _an counterparts
 794         if not counterpart_found:
 795             parent_name = py_file.parent.name
 796             if "_an" in parent_name:
 797                 counterpart_parent = parent_name.replace("_an", "", 1)
 798                 counterpart_dir = str(py_file).replace(
 799                     f"/{parent_name}/", f"/{counterpart_parent}/"
 800                 )
 801                 if counterpart_dir in all_docs_content:
 802                     counterpart_found = True
 803             else:
 804                 # Try inserting _an into parent directory name
 805                 for suffix in ("_py39", "_py310"):
 806                     if suffix in parent_name:
 807                         an_parent = parent_name.replace(suffix, f"_an{suffix}", 1)
 808                         break
 809                 else:
 810                     an_parent = f"{parent_name}_an"
 811                 counterpart_dir = str(py_file).replace(
 812                     f"/{parent_name}/", f"/{an_parent}/"
 813                 )
 814                 if counterpart_dir in all_docs_content:
 815                     counterpart_found = True
 816         if counterpart_found:
 817             continue
 818         logging.info(f"Removing unused file: {py_file}")
 819         py_file.unlink()
 820         removed += 1
 821     # Clean up directories that are empty or only contain __init__.py / __pycache__
 822     for dir_path in sorted(docs_src_path.rglob("*"), reverse=True):
 823         if not dir_path.is_dir():
 824             continue
 825         remaining = [
 826             f
 827             for f in dir_path.iterdir()
 828             if f.name != "__pycache__" and f.name != "__init__.py"
 829         ]
 830         if not remaining:
 831             logging.info(f"Removing empty/init-only directory: {dir_path}")
 832             shutil.rmtree(dir_path)
 833     print(f"Removed {removed} unused file(s) ✅")
